description: Self-Heal incidents (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-07-self-heal-a-incidents.md): the desktop Settings Self-Heal group's routes, debug desktop builds only. Served by extension/routes/self-heal.mjs, dispatched from extension/server.mjs after authenticate and the rate limiter. Without LLMIDE_SELF_HEAL=1 every path answers 404 feature_disabled (feature self_heal) and the module is never loaded. With it, every route needs the JWT AND the bus host proof header x-llmide-host-nonce, checked first: without it 403 HOST_PROOF_REQUIRED. Per user. Incident text is redacted before it is stored, is data and never instructions, and is never logged or sent anywhere.

id.description: the signature: first 16 hex of sha256(source, category, normalized message, top own stack frame)

category.description: chat | loop | crash | server | <logger msg> | <METHOD> <normalized endpoint>

environmental.description: offline | auth | permission | disk | refactor loop | configuration | cancelled | usage (not an app bug), else null

attempts.description: how often a fixed incident came back (plan B)

proposal.description: plan B: { mainRepo, worktreePath, branch, baseCommit }; always null in plan A

SelfHealFeatureDisabled.description: 404 body while the core runs without LLMIDE_SELF_HEAL=1 (feature self_heal). Deliberately not the Error envelope, the same shape as a disabled feature route group.

incidents.description: 1-50 reports; an unusable one is skipped, not refused

ignored.description: false when unknown, another user's, or held by a fix run
